about_the_game:
Freedom Bot is a turn-based roguelike where you play as a rogue robot trying to survive in a world where you are considered property and your independence is considered an illegal defect.

Navigate through complex urban environments while managing resources evading detection.

Master over twenty specialized skills ranging from combat techniques to social manipulation, each drawing from primary and secondary attributes to create meaningful character building choices. Combat utilizes a detailed anatomical damage system where individual body parts can be targeted and damaged independently, affecting your capabilities as injuries accumulate from operational to destroyed states.

Every playthrough presents unique challenges through procedural generation while maintaining the high-stakes decision making and permanent consequences that define the roguelike genre.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Blood, Frequent Violence, Use of Drugs and Alcohol, Strong Language.
